design_principles: Frictionless Experience: Mobile-first, single-column stacks with thumb-friendly zones
Quiet Interface: Fewer choices, gentle transitions, soft edges, progressive disclosure
Information Clarity: Generous white space (48px+ padding), high contrast on key data metrics
Card-less Dashboards: Use crisp dividers or very subtle background shifts instead of bulky cards

typography.font_family_headings: font-sans (Use Manrope or system-ui for a clean geometric look)

spacing_and_layout.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto h-screen relative bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col sm:border sm:border-zinc-200
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main elements, rounded-full for pills/buttons

buttons.primary: w-full h-14 bg-zinc-950 text-white rounded-full font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: w-full h-14 bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-950 rounded-full font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-zinc-200 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2

inputs.default: w-full h-14 bg-zinc-50 border border-zinc-200 rounded-2xl px-4 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-950 focus:border-transparent transition-all outline-none text-zinc-950 placeholder:text-zinc-400

bottom_navigation.container: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-20 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-zinc-100 flex items-center justify-around px-4 pb-safe-area z-50
bottom_navigation.item_inactive: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-600 transition-colors

onboarding_hero.description: Minimalist person walking in front of a building, used for auth/onboarding screen background.

nutrition_header.description: Healthy meal on a plate, used for the nutrition tracking section empty state or header.

ai_coach_avatar.description: Abstract 3D orb glowing soft blue and mint. Use this as the avatar profile picture for the AI Coach Chatbot.

Authentication.layout: Full height, image taking top 50% with overlay, bottom 50% white card with rounded-t-[2rem].
elements: Brand Logo/Text centered at the top of the white card.
Google Auth button (Secondary style with Google icon).
Use subtle text links for 'Sign up' / 'Forgot Password'.

Dashboard.layout: Scrollable content with pb-24 (to account for bottom nav).
elements: Header: Greeting ('Good morning, Alex') + Profile avatar.
Hero Metric: Large circular progress ring for Activity/Steps centered. Text inside.
Sub-metrics Grid (Bento style): 2x2 grid for Calories, Active Minutes, Water, Distance. Soft rounded-2xl blocks (bg-zinc-50).

Workout_Logger.layout: Sticky header for Date/Title, scrollable list of exercises.
elements: Exercise list using clean horizontal rows: Name on left, Sets/Reps/Weight inputs on right.
Use subtle dividers instead of heavy borders.
Floating Action Button (FAB) or bottom fixed button for '+ Add Exercise'.

Nutrition.layout: Daily calorie progress at top (linear progress bar).
elements: Each meal shows total calories on the right.
Image asset in header if list is empty.
Sticky Top Bar: AI Coach name + Avatar (`ai_coach_avatar` asset).
Message Bubbles: User (bg-zinc-950 text-white, right aligned), AI (bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-950, left aligned).
Input Area: Fixed at bottom just above tab bar, simple input + Send icon.
Recharts / standard BarCharts using brand accent colors.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The entire application must be built within a mobile-simulated wrapper on the web: `<div className='max-w-md mx-auto h-screen relative bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col sm:border sm:border-zinc-200'>`
All navigation must be handled internally via React state or React Router, keeping the bottom navigation bar sticky at the bottom of the `.max-w-md` container.
Do NOT use generic Card components with heavy borders and shadows. Use flat, card-less design (e.g. `bg-zinc-50 rounded-2xl p-4`).
Use `lucide-react` for all icons (e.g. Home, Dumbbell, Apple, LineChart, MessageCircle).
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case format (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='nav-workouts-tab'`).
Implement Recharts for the Progress_Charts screen using the colors specified in the `brand.accents` object.
Ensure hover states text colors are explicitly defined, but since it's a mobile design, focus heavily on active states for touch feedback (`active:bg-zinc-200`).
